# Content Processing API - Complete Machine-Readable Guide for AI Agents
> This file (`/llms.txt`) is the definitive, self-contained reference for autonomous AI agents, LLMs, and automated HTTP clients.
> Target Base URL: `https://<your-host-domain>` (or `http://localhost:8000` in local dev).
> Any AI agent given `https://<your-host-domain>/llms.txt` can understand and execute all operations below without human intervention.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Async Task Pattern

Processing media (cutting silences, YouTube slicing, meme generation, etc.) requires time. The API implements a standardized asynchronous tracking loop:

```
[Agent] ---> GET /tasks/init --------------------------> Returns task_id
[Agent] ---> POST /endpoint (with task_id) ------------> Begins processing
[Agent] ---> Loop: GET /status/{task_id} (every 2-3s) -> Checks progress %
[Agent] <--- Status: "completed" or final HTTP response -> Fetches result
```

### Task Lifecycle Endpoints:
- **`GET /tasks/init`**:
  Initializes a task session.
  - Returns: `{"task_id": "<uuid-string>"}`
- **`GET /status/{task_id}`**:
  Inspects progress.
  - Returns: `{"task": {"id": "<task_id>", "status": "pending|processing|completed|failed", "porcentage": 0-100}}`
- **`GET /tasks/clean`**:
  Maintenance route. Cleans old temporary folders.

---

## 2. YouTube Clips Engine

### `POST /video/youtube-clips`
Downloads a YouTube video, excises unwanted segments (ads, sponsors), segments into clips, requests viral titles and keywords from Grok AI, renders vertical 3:4 canvas with styled ASS subtitles, and uploads results to Google Drive (or returns local paths).

- **Method**: `POST`
- **Path**: `/video/youtube-clips`
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`

#### Request Body Parameters:
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | **Yes** | — | Full YouTube video URL or ID (e.g. `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ`). |
| `task_id` | string | **Yes** | — | Task ID from `GET /tasks/init`. |
| `quality` | string/integer | No | `"720p"` | Video download quality: `"480p"`, `"720p"`, or `"1080p"` (also accepts `480`, `720`, `1080`). Default fallback set via `YOUTUBE_DOWNLOAD_QUALITY`. |
| `num_clips` | integer | No | `null` | Exact number of clips to cut. |
| `clip_duration` | integer | No | `180` | Duration in seconds per clip (default: 3 minutes). |
| `composition_mode` | string | No | `"normal"` | `"normal"` (standard 3:4 bars) or `"fullscreen"` (blurred background). |
| `add_cta` | boolean | No | `false` | When `true`, appends a 3-second animated channel outro/CTA card. |
| `exclude_segments` | array | No | `[]` | List of intervals `[{"start": 10.0, "end": 25.5}]` in seconds to cut out before segmenting. |

#### Example Request:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://<your-host-domain>/video/youtube-clips" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ",
    "task_id": "b3e9447a-...",
    "quality": "720p",
    "num_clips": 3,
    "clip_duration": 60,
    "composition_mode": "normal",
    "add_cta": true,
    "exclude_segments": [{"start": 15.0, "end": 35.0}]
  }'
```

#### Storage Behavior:
- **No local storage**: All generated video clips are uploaded directly to Google Drive Folder: `11nrbGOByVtQHs2b1ipwTo41khIY1-V6F`.
- Temporary files on the server are automatically purged immediately after upload.
- The response returns public Google Drive URLs in `segments` and detailed file metadata in `files` (including `file_id` for deletion).

#### Example Response:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "task_id": "b3e9447a-...",
  "segments": [
    "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D5E.../view?usp=sharing",
    "https://drive.google.com/file/d/6F7G8H9I0J.../view?usp=sharing"
  ],
  "files": [
    {
      "file_id": "1A2B3C4D5E...",
      "drive_url": "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D5E.../view?usp=sharing",
      "filename": "yt_clip_part1.mp4"
    }
  ],
  "count": 2,
  "folder_id": "11nrbGOByVtQHs2b1ipwTo41khIY1-V6F",
  "message": "Se generaron y subieron 2 clips a Google Drive exitosamente"
}
```

### 2.1. `DELETE /video/youtube-clips/{file_id}`
Deletes a generated video clip from Google Drive to free up space.
- **Method**: `DELETE`
- **Path**: `/video/youtube-clips/{file_id}` (or `/video/drive/{file_id}`)
- **Path Parameter**: `file_id` (Accepts either the raw Google Drive File ID `1A2B3C4D5E...` OR the full Drive URL `https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D5E.../view?usp=sharing`).
- **Example Request**:
  ```bash
  curl -X DELETE "https://<your-host-domain>/video/youtube-clips/1A2B3C4D5E..."
  ```
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "file_id": "1A2B3C4D5E...",
    "message": "Archivo eliminado de Google Drive correctamente"
  }
  ```

---

## 3. Video Processing Endpoints

### 3.1. `POST /video/cut`
Removes silence segments from an uploaded video file.
- **Content-Type**: `multipart/form-data`
- **Fields**:
  - `file`: binary video file (`.mp4`, `.mov`, `.avi`, `.mkv`, `.flv`, `.wmv`, `.webm`).
  - `task_id`: string (required).
- **Response**: `{"success": true, "file_path": "...", "filename": "cut_video.mp4", "message": "..."}`

### 3.2. `POST /video/zoom`
Applies dynamic zoom and pan effect to keep audience engagement high.
- **Content-Type**: `multipart/form-data`
- **Fields**:
  - `file`: binary video file.
  - `task_id`: string (required).
- **Response**: `{"success": true, "file_path": "...", "filename": "zoom_video.mp4"}`

### 3.3. `POST /video/meme`
Generates modern or classic meme video templates with top text overlay.
- **Content-Type**: `multipart/form-data`
- **Fields**:
  - `file`: binary video file.
  - `text`: string (meme caption text).
  - `template`: string (`"meme_modern_thin"` default, or `"meme_classic_bold"`).
  - `color`: string (`"white"` default, or `"black"`).
  - `return_file`: boolean (`false` uploads to Google Drive and returns JSON with `drive_link`, `true` streams the `.mp4` file directly).
- **Response (`return_file=false`)**:
  ```json
  {"success": true, "task_id": "...", "drive_link": "https://drive.google.com/...", "file_id": "...", "filename": "meme.mp4"}
  ```

---

## 4. Audio Processing Endpoints

### 4.1. `POST /audio/cut`
Removes dead silence from beginning, middle, and end of audio.
- **Content-Type**: `multipart/form-data`
- **Fields**:
  - `file`: binary audio (`.mp3`, `.wav`, `.m4a`, `.aac`, `.flac`, `.ogg`, `.mpga`).
  - `google_token`: string (optional Google OAuth token).
  - `return_file`: boolean (default: `false` = upload to Google Drive and return JSON; `true` = binary stream download).
- **Response (`return_file=false`)**:
  ```json
  {"task_id": "...", "drive_link": "https://drive.google.com/...", "filename": "audio.mp3"}
  ```

### 4.2. `GET /audio/download/{task_id}`
Downloads the processed audio file generated by an async task.
- **Returns**: Binary stream (`audio/mpeg`) with cleanup after download.

---

## 5. Image & Tweet Card Engine

### `POST /image/tweet`
Renders a simulated viral tweet card with profile avatar and caption.
- **Content-Type**: `multipart/form-data`
- **Fields**:
  - `text`: string (tweet content).
  - `return_file`: boolean (default: `true` returns binary PNG image; `false` returns local path JSON).
- **Response (`return_file=true`)**: Binary PNG image (`image/png`).

---

## 6. AI Script & Content Generation

### 6.1. `POST /create/template_script`
Generates structured video script content using a designated AI provider.
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "message": "Tema del video...",
    "context": "Contexto o tono...",
    "provider": "grok", // Options: "grok", "openai", "gemini", "claude"
    "api_key": null     // Optional custom API key; defaults to server key
  }
  ```
- **Response**: `{"response": "Contenido generado..."}`

### 6.2. `POST /script/generate`
Direct prompt-to-script generator.
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "message": "Escribe un guión corto sobre inteligencia artificial",
    "context": "Tono entretenido para TikTok",
    "provider": "grok",
    "api_key": null
  }
  ```
- **Response**: `{"response": "..."}`

### 6.3. `POST /script/generate_from_template`
Generates script strictly adhering to a prompt template, with optional bilingual (Spanish + English) JSON output.
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "template": "System prompt or custom template...",
    "tema": "Tema a desarrollar...",
    "provider": "grok",
    "bilingual": true // When true, returns {"es": "...", "en": "..."}
  }
  ```

---

## 7. ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech (TTS) & Quotas

### 7.1. Public User Endpoints

#### `POST /elevenlabs/tts`
Generates high-fidelity voice audio while tracking character quotas per user email.
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "text": "Texto a convertir en voz...",
    "voice_id": "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",
    "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2", // optional
    "output_format": "mp3_44100_128"       // optional
  }
  ```
- **Response**: Binary audio file (`audio/mpeg` or `audio/wav`).

#### `GET /elevenlabs/voices`
Lists all available ElevenLabs voices with their IDs and preview samples.
- **Response**: `{"voices": [{"voice_id": "...", "name": "...", "category": "..."}]}`

#### `GET /elevenlabs/usage/{email}`
Checks remaining character quota for a user.
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "character_limit": 10000,
    "characters_used": 1500,
    "characters_remaining": 8500,
    "is_active": true
  }
  ```

### 7.2. Admin Endpoints (Require `X-Admin-Key` Header)
- **`GET /elevenlabs/admin/users`**: List all users.
- **`POST /elevenlabs/admin/users`**: Register user `{"email": "...", "character_limit": 10000}`.
- **`GET /elevenlabs/admin/users/{email}`**: Get user profile.
- **`PATCH /elevenlabs/admin/users/{email}/limit`**: Update quota `{"character_limit": 50000}`.
- **`PATCH /elevenlabs/admin/users/{email}/status`**: Activate/Deactivate `{"is_active": true|false}`.
- **`POST /elevenlabs/admin/users/{email}/reset`**: Reset characters used count to 0.
- **`DELETE /elevenlabs/admin/users/{email}`**: Delete user record.

---

## 8. Server Discovery & Metadata Endpoints

- **`GET /`**: Entrypoint with discovery navigation.
- **`GET /llms.txt`**: This document (plain text).
- **`GET /openapi.json`**: Standard OpenAPI 3.0 specification for automated tool calling.
- **`GET /docs`**: Interactive Swagger UI.
- **`GET /endpoints`**: Dynamic JSON array listing all registered routes.

---

## 9. HTTP Status Codes & Error Handling

- **`200 OK`**: Operation completed successfully.
- **`202 Accepted`**: Background processing in progress.
- **`400 Bad Request`**: Missing parameter, invalid file extension, or bad format.
- **`403 Forbidden`**: Invalid or missing `X-Admin-Key`.
- **`404 Not Found`**: Task ID, file, or user not found.
- **`410 Gone`**: Temporary file has expired or was already downloaded.
- **`500 Internal Server Error`**: Processing error. Inspect `"detail"` string in the JSON response.
